# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b45 — Generic roller shutters and independent cover devices

## Fix: unclassified native roller shutters are selectable

Several real Home Assistant `cover.*` roller shutters report native `supported_features: 15` (OPEN, CLOSE, SET_POSITION and STOP) **without a `device_class`**, so beta44 excluded them from the **Shades / Σκίαστρα, περσίδες και ρολά παραθύρων** selector.

Beta45 accepts a native `cover.*` with verified CLOSE support if it has either an explicitly supported `blind`, `shade`, `shutter` or `curtain` device class **or no class at all**. Clearly non-shading classes including `garage`, `gate`, `door`, `window`, `awning` and `damper` remain excluded; unfamiliar non-empty classes also require explicit support rather than silently becoming shade actuators.

The picker respects Home Assistant's **entity-area override first, then native device area**, includes classless template entities and temporarily `unknown`/`unavailable` covers when their CLOSE feature remains advertised, and does not list hidden, disabled or Manager-generated entities. An unknown/unavailable cover **cannot be actuated**, and no default automatic authorization is added.

Regression tests cover the six reported roller-shutter entity IDs from **Gästezimmer, Wohnzimmer, Schlafzimmer and Küche** and verify all class exclusions, wrong-room rejection, unknown state, native Close support and startup with automation OFF.

## Existing beta45 feature: a controller for every cover

One logical **Window Shade Controller** child is registered under its Home Assistant room for each selected cover. It offers the following entities, each scoped to the actual cover:

- **Associated window contact** select: choose a real same-room Window-class binary sensor. An open, unknown, removed or missing linked window blocks movement.
- **Automatic solar shade cooling** switch: opt-in for this one cover; manual opening or closing persists a pause until deliberately rearmed. No blanket room command is issued.
- **Announce before movement** switch: opt-in per cover; uses the existing Announcement Hub or direct TTS/notification path. If a required notice cannot be submitted, no movement happens. Recheck of all conditions occurs before movement.
- **Close above room temperature** number: 18–36°C, default 25°C, using fresh real room temperature.

Opening is limited to shades that Home Environment Manager previously **closed and confirmed**, with persistent ownership/release tracking. A user-closed cover is never adopted as automatic property. Sunset and stable-cloud/reduced-temperature release conditions retain the beta44 rules.

## Clear and translated setup guidance

Both initial setup and Options forms now have distinct, instructional descriptions for:
- **Controlled Devices / Συσκευές**: physical `climate.*`, `humidifier.*` and `fan.*` support; explains actual heat/cool/dry/humidity/temperature/fan capabilities, and that selection never immediately controls equipment.
- **Shades / Σκίαστρα, περσίδες και ρολά παραθύρων**: native/generic CLOSE-capable covers, explicit exclusions, opt-in, linked contact, pre-move announcement, temperature threshold and unavailable-state hold.

Each description is localized for **all 38 supported languages**, notably Greek, German and English.

## Important safety and compatibility notes

A missing `device_class` does **not prove** that a device is safe window shading. Choose only actual window blinds/roller shutters and verify room assignments before arming control. Selecting a cover does not move it. Physical motion still requires verified native availability, exact same-room authorization, linked closed window sensor, fresh temperature and clear solar weather, sun elevation, successful configured announcement when enabled, persistent record storage and rechecks immediately before each command.

The canonical domain remains **`environment_manager`** with no migration or duplicate integrations. All prior beta44 safety fixes are retained. Existing beta44 room-wide settings keep their legacy behavior until each cover is configured individually. Stable v0.5.1 and all earlier beta tags remain unchanged.

## Update using HACS

Home Environment Manager → **Redownload / version selection** → **Show beta versions** → **v0.6.0b45** → restart Home Assistant. Back up your configuration first. Then open **Configure → Room sources → Shades** and select your cover entities. Open the new cover child device and choose its linked window contact before explicitly enabling its auto switch.

This is an **experimental beta**. Automated tests do not replace hardware-specific physical commissioning; verify the real blind/window combination before authorizing movements.
